'''January 2001 Minneapolis tournament (30 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 30 January 2001. [[Joshua Grace]] won it. It is known from Justin Alfs's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1694">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-02-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-30d1694/ moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-30], DeckTech (Justin "MoffWicket" Alfs, 2 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-02-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-30d1694/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]
